meta.title: About Us — CareBridge
meta.description: CareBridge is a 100% youth-led club based at SHSID. Our structure: Treasurer, Outreach, Event and Design.

story.title: Our Story
story.body: Dedicated to providing compassionate pediatric care to all children, Carebridge is a 100% youth led nonprofit organization and school club based in SHSID. We aim to empower children whose medical conditions' severity remains unseen by the vast public, especially those who lack parental care. We aim to achieve our goal through hosting awareness-raising sessions, fundraising events, and service opportunities to both develop a sense of empathy among teenagers and support children with love and care. We aspire to create a world where joy and respect are no longer privileges to healthy children, but a commodity that surrounds everyone.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: We support, motivate, and empower children in healthcare. We bridge the gap between youth and healthcare communities through fundraising, awareness, and direct volunteering.
